description: User story under REQ-189 for the pure check (FBS-212). Structural checks, the six-entry interruption catalogue covered by a step of any kind or ruled out with a reason, wireframe file rules (markdown; HTML self-contained across href, src, srcset, CSS url() and @import; PNG only on a record declared as-built; any other extension refused; bytes hashed, headings ignored), wireframePerStep for central only, notApplicable for none and for a grandfathered tree.
asA: a product owner about to open DEFINE
iWant: one check that tells me whether the journey has a way in, a way out, no dead ends, an answer for every way a person gets interrupted, and, only when the UI is central, a wireframe per step
soThat: the questions are answered before requirements are drawn, without being asked for drawings a light product does not need

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a declared light or central product with a journey, when the journey check verb runs, then it evaluates discovery:journeyPresent (at least one journey with an entry and an exit), discovery:stepsNameScreens (every JourneyStep.screenId resolves), discovery:reachable (every step reachable from an entry and every non-exit step with a next or a returnsTo) and discovery:interruptions, prints one line per check, and exits 0 when every check passes.

[happy] Given the interruption catalogue [lostEmail | closedTab | deadBattery | expiredLink | switchedDevice | lostSignal], when discovery:interruptions evaluates a journey, then each catalogue entry is either covered by a step of that journey, of any kind, or ruled out as notApplicable with a reason of at least 20 characters, and an entry that is neither fails the check with an id naming the journey and the entry.

[happy] Given a central product, when discovery:wireframePerStep evaluates, then it fails for every step whose Screen.wireframe is null or does not resolve on disk, and given a light product the same check reports notApplicable and never fails for a missing wireframe.

[happy] Given a wireframe file, when the check reads it, then a .md file is accepted as-is, an .html file is accepted when no href, src or srcset attribute value and no CSS url() or @import target (in a style element or a style attribute) starts http:, https: or //, a .png file is accepted only when JourneyRecord.asBuilt is true, and the file's bytes are hashed with sha256 without any inspection of its headings or sections.

[failure] Given an .html wireframe carrying an external stylesheet, script, image or font URL through any of href, src, srcset, CSS url() or @import, when the journey check verb runs, then discovery:wireframeSelfContained fails naming the file and the first offending URL and the verb exits 4.

[edge] Given a journey with a non-exit step that has no next and no returnsTo, when discovery:reachable evaluates, then it fails naming that step as a dead end, distinct from the why it gives a step no entry reaches.
[must-not] Given a declared none product or a tree with no journey.json, when the journey check verb runs, then it reports notApplicable with the reason, reads no wireframe file, and exits 0.

[failure] Given a Screen.wireframe whose extension is outside .md, .html and .png, or a .png on a record whose JourneyRecord.asBuilt is false, when the journey check verb runs, then discovery:wireframeFormat fails naming the file and the rule it breaks and the verb exits 4, on a light product as on a central one.

title: the journey is checked for structure, interruption answers and wireframe files in proportion to the declaration
